name: TNA iMPACT!
description: TNA iMPACT offers a unique style of wrestling that features a blend of the traditional with high-flying athleticism and cutting edge action. TNA's roster includes the biggest names in wrestling today, and the hottest new stars in the sport.

videos.title: June 4, 2004
videos.overview: On the first ever edition of IMPACT!, Chris Sabin, Elix Skipper, Michael Shane and a mystery competitor go to war in a Fatal 4-Way Match! Also, Jeff Jarrett confronts "The American Dream" Dusty Rhodes.

videos.title: June 11, 2004
videos.overview: The X-Division takes the spotlight with a six-man international tag match main event, and Kid Kash takes on Amazing Red.

videos.title: June 18, 2004
videos.overview: TNA counts down to its two-year anniversary.

videos.title: June 25, 2004
videos.overview: Jeff Jarrett stakes his claim to the World Heavyweight Championship after Wednesday's controversial title match conclusion.

videos.title: July 2, 2004
videos.overview: All eight competitors in Wednesday's Gauntlet of the Gold compete in a tag match, and Dennis Rodman makes his presence felt in the Impact Zone.

videos.title: July 9, 2004
videos.overview: X-Division Champion AJ Styles faces both Chris Sabin and Petey Williams in a non-title three-way bout, and 3 Live Kru collides with Jeff Jarrett's Elite Guard.

videos.title: July 16, 2004
videos.overview: iMPACT features international warfare when Triple X battles Team Japan, and Jeff Jarrett joins Jeff Hammond on Six Points of Impact.

videos.title: July 23, 2004
videos.overview: AJ Styles prepares for the high-wire action of Ultimate X by taking on Jerrelle Clark, and Jeff Jarrett calls out TNA's newest signee, Jeff Hardy.

videos.title: July 30, 2004
videos.overview: Jeff Hardy makes his in-ring debut against Kid Romeo, and co-X-Division champions Kazarian and Michael Shane duke it out with former NWA World Tag Team Champions Triple X.

videos.title: August 6, 2004
videos.overview: AJ Styles and America's Most Wanted are in action, and Jeff Jarrett doesn't want to wait until next Wednesday's PPV to get his hands on Jeff Hardy.

videos.title: August 13, 2004
videos.overview: Raven, AJ Styles and Jeff Hardy are in action, and Jeff Jarrett faces Psiscosis in a non-title bout.

videos.title: August 20, 2004
videos.overview: AJ Styles, Jeff Hardy and Ron Killings team up to face Frankie Kazarian, Michael Shane and Jason Cross.

videos.title: August 27, 2004
videos.overview: Chris Harris takes on Christopher Daniels in a Sudden Death Match, and a suspended Dusty Rhodes makes his way into the iMPACT! Zone.

videos.title: September 3, 2004
videos.overview: AJ Styles and Jeff Hardy team to face the Elite Guard, and 3 Live Kru takes on NOSAWA, Alex Shelley and Abyss, with Monty Brown also in action.

videos.title: September 10, 2004
videos.overview: Team Canada faces NWA World Tag Team Champions Chris Harris and Elix Skipper in a non-title match, and the potent team of AJ Styles and Jeff Hardy take on the Naturals.

videos.title: September 17, 2004
videos.overview: Alex Shelley challenges AJ Styles, Kid Kash and Dallas take on Chris Sabin and Amazing Red, and TNA's King of the Mountain, Jeff Jarrett, is also in action.

videos.title: September 24, 2004
videos.overview: The Tag Team Championships are on the line when Chris Harris and Primetime Elix Skipper defend against Christopher Daniels and James Storm, and Abyss is also in action.

videos.title: October 1, 2004
videos.overview: Vince Russo makes an announcement about Jeff Jarrett's next title contender, and an X-Division Six-Way Free-For-All features AJ Styles, Alex Shelley, Kazarian and more.

videos.title: October 8, 2004
videos.overview: Rowdy Roddy Piper makes his first iMPACT! appearance with a special announcement concerning Victory Road, and Abyss grapples with Jeff Hardy in the first match of the World Heavyweight Championship #1 Contendership Tournament.

videos.title: October 15, 2004
videos.overview: Monty Brown and Jeff Hardy duke it out with a championship opportunity at Victory Road on the line, and Team Canada challenges Storm and Daniels for the NWA World Tag Team Championships.

videos.title: October 22, 2004
videos.overview: Will Jeff Jarrett accept the challenge to compete against Jeff Hardy in his speciality, the ladder match? Also, Michael Shane and Frankie Kazarian team up to face Chris Sabin and Sonjay Dutt.

videos.title: October 29, 2004
videos.overview: Dusty Rhodes and Vince Russo campaign to be the TNA Director of Authority, and a Six-Man X-Division Gauntlet Match with Victory Road implications features Sonjay Dutt, Michael Shane, Shark Boy and more.

videos.title: November 5, 2004
videos.overview: Jeff Jarrett attempts to soften up Jeff Hardy before their match at Victory Road, and Jarrett and Petey Williams take on AJ Styles and a mystery opponent.

videos.title: November 11, 2004
videos.overview: The newly minted Kings of Wrestling stake their claim to dominance in TNA, and Raven receives a rematch with 'The Alpha Male' Monty Brown.

videos.title: November 19, 2004
videos.overview: Dusty Rhodes announces the stipulation for the massive main event at Turning Point, and Kid Kash, Michael Shane and Frankie Kazarian take on Sonjay Dutt, Sonny Siaki and Hector Garza in a Six-Man Tag Match.

videos.title: November 26, 2004
videos.overview: BANG! Diamond Dallas Page makes his presence felt in TNA, and AJ Styles tries to overcome the man advantage to defeat Scott Hall.

videos.title: December 3, 2004
videos.overview: In the biggest 'iMPACT!' main event to date, Monty Brown gains a championship opportunity against Jeff Jarrett, and Kid Kash goes toe-to-toe with Chris Sabin.

videos.title: December 10, 2004
videos.overview: Hector Garza battles AJ Styles for the #1 contendership to the NWA World Heavyweight Championship, and Diamond Dallas Page confronts the Kings of Wrestling.

videos.title: December 17, 2004
videos.overview: Current star meets future star when Jeff Hardy tries to stave off the challenge of Booby Roode (with Scott D'Amore), and Jeff Jarrett makes a defense of his NWA World Heavyweight Championship against Hector Garza.

videos.title: December 24, 2004
videos.overview: On a Christmas Eve edition, Roddy Piper brings good cheer to the Impact Zone and AJ Styles tries to wrap up a win against Johnny Devine.

videos.title: December 31, 2004
videos.overview: Old school meets new school when Scott Hall faces Hector Garza, and Monty Brown makes a bold New Year's resolution.

videos.title: January 7, 2005
videos.overview: On the first iMPACT! of 2005, NWA World Heavyweight Champion Jeff Jarrett speaks out about his next title defense, Chris Sabin battles Bobby Roode, and AJ Styles and Petey Williams are also in action.

videos.title: January 14, 2005
videos.overview: In the final iMPACT! before Final Resolution 2005, Chris Sabin goes to war with Christopher Daniels with a spot in Ultimate X on the line, and AJ Styles and Dustin Rhodes are also in action.

videos.title: January 21, 2005
videos.overview: After the events of Final Resolution 2005, a new #1 contender is named for the NWA World Heavyweight Championship, and AJ Styles faces Christopher Daniels in a 10-Minute Challenge with X-Division Championship implications.

videos.title: January 28, 2005
videos.overview: Jeff Jarrett previews his next title defense against Kevin Nash, Diamond Dallas Page confronts the Kings of Wrestling, and Monty Brown goes toe-to-toe with Johnny Devine of Team Canada.

videos.title: February 4, 2005
videos.overview: Diamond Dallas Page and Monty Brown test their newfound alliance against the Naturals, and AJ Styles, Abyss and Jeff Hardy are all in action.

videos.title: February 11, 2005
videos.overview: It's a three-way X-Division shoot-out when Chris Sabin, Elix Skipper and Shark Boy meet head-to-head-to-head, and Jeff Jarrett and Kevin Nash speak out in the final iMPACT! before Against All Odds 2005.

videos.title: February 18, 2005
videos.overview: As TNA feels the fallout from Against All Odds 2005, Dusty Rhodes makes a series of pronouncements for the upcoming Destination X, and Lance Hoyt tests his luck against 'The Alpha Male' Monty Brown.

videos.title: February 25, 2005
videos.overview: Chris Candido takes on Elix Skipper, and tensions boil over between Diamond Dallas Page and Jeff Jarrett ahead of their title bout at Destination X 2005.

videos.title: March 4, 2005
videos.overview: Dusty Rhodes adds a twist to the NWA World Heavyweight Championship match at Destination X, and AJ Styles defends the X-Division Championship against Kid Kash.

videos.title: March 11, 2005
videos.overview: Diamond Dallas Page confronts Jeff Jarrett ahead of their championship bout at Destination X, and Christopher Daniels battles Chris Sabin in an Ultimate X Qualifying Match.

videos.title: March 18, 2005
videos.overview: Jeff Jarrett celebrates his title victory and attempts to solidify his position of power in TNA, and Diamond Dallas Page and Syxx-Pac team up for tag action.

videos.title: March 25, 2005
videos.overview: The main event for the inaugural Lockdown pay-per-view is set by Dusty Rhodes, and America's Most Wanted defend the tag team championships against Phi Delta Slam.

videos.title: April 1, 2005
videos.overview: In a #1 Contender’s Four-Way bout, Petey Williams, Elix Skipper, Michael Shane and Chris Sabin battle for a X-Division Title opportunity at Lockdown.

videos.title: April 8, 2005
videos.overview: Dusty Rhodes makes a historic decree that changes the complexion of Lockdown, AJ Styles goes toe-to-toe with Chase Stevens and Chris Sabin battles it out with Michael Shane.

videos.title: April 15, 2005
videos.overview: Diamond Dallas Page and Sean Waltman face off with ‘The Outlaw’ and Monty Brown ahead of their main event showdown inside of Lethal Lockdown, Konnan takes on Eric Young and 3 Live Kru squares off with Team Canada.

videos.title: April 22, 2005
videos.overview: Just days from Lockdown 2005, the dream team of Jeff Hardy and AJ Styles take on Raven and Abyss in the main event, and America’s Most Wanted rekindles their rivalry with the Naturals.

videos.title: April 29, 2005
videos.overview: As the IMPACT Zone reels from the events of Lockdown, Dusty Rhodes announces a shocking guest referee for the World Championship bout at the inaugural Hard Justice!

videos.title: May 6, 2005
videos.overview: The Outlaw squares off with Konnan, Shocker takes on Sonjay Dutt, Raven has harsh words for Jeff Hardy, and Chris Sabin battles Michael Shane.

videos.title: May 13, 2005
videos.overview: A 10-Man Gauntlet Match featuring Bobby Roode, Petey Williams, Chris Sabin, Abyss, Trytan and more determines who will enter the Hard Justice 20-Man as the coveted 20th entrant!

videos.title: May 20, 2005
videos.overview: After the cataclysmic finale to the inaugural Hard Justice pay-per-view, Dusty Rhodes announces a monumental main event for Slammiversary 2005.

videos.title: May 27, 2005
videos.overview: In the main event, Jeff Jarrett and Monty Brown team to face World Champion AJ Styles and Sean Waltman, and 3 Live Kru takes on America's Most Wanted.

videos.title: June 24, 2005
videos.overview: In the return of iMPACT! as an online-exclusive 'webcast,' Raven revels in his recent championship victory before he's confronted by a monstrous contender.

videos.title: July 1, 2005
videos.overview: AJ Styles takes on Alex Shelley, Sean Waltman tries to deep-six Sonjay Dutt, Simon Diamond and Trytan combine their efforts against America's Most Wanted!

videos.title: July 8, 2005
videos.overview: Jeff Jarrett makes known his dissatisfaction with being held out of the championship picture, Petey Williams takes on Amazing Red and Zach Gowen is in action against Mikey Batts.

videos.title: July 15, 2005
videos.overview: Ahead of their pay-per-view clash at No Surrender, AJ Styles & Sean Waltman try to co-exist against formidable foes in Bobby Roode and A1 of Team Canada.

videos.title: July 22, 2005
videos.overview: The 2005 Super X Cup takes the stage, with first round matches including Sonjay Dutt vs. Samoa Joe and AJ Styles vs. Matt Bentley, and Jeff Jarrett tries to throw Raven off his game.

videos.title: July 29, 2005
videos.overview: Round 1 of the Super X Cup rolls on with Chris Sabin facing Petey Williams and Shocker taking on Alex Shelley, and Raven welcomes an extreme ally from his past to even the odds against Jeff Jarrett and Rhino.

videos.title: August 5, 2005
videos.overview: Alex Shelley tries to chop Samoa Joe down to size in the semi-finals of the Super X Cup, Raven & Sabu take on Simon Diamond & David Young and The Naturals battle Team Canada with the Tag Team Championships on the line.

videos.title: August 12, 2005
videos.overview: On the final edition of iMPACT! before Sacrifice 2005, AJ Styles tries to punch his ticket to the finals of the Super X Cup with a win over Petey Williams!

videos.title: August 19, 2005
videos.overview: With Sacrifice 2005 in the rear view mirror, the Candido Cup kicks off with tag team tournament action. Rhino takes on Sonny Siaki, and Samoa Joe, Christopher Daniels and AJ Styles have a three-way confrontation in the ring and more.

videos.title: August 26, 2005
videos.overview: The Candido Cup continues with two more Round 1 matches, and World Heavyweight Champion Raven tries to fend off Team Canada's Bobby Roode.

videos.title: September 2, 2005
videos.overview: In Round 2 Candido Cup action, it's Sean Waltman & Alex Shelley against Konnan & Lance Hoyt, while Ron Killings & Sonjay Dutt face Shocker & Chris Sabin on the other side of the bracket.

videos.title: September 9, 2005
videos.overview: On the final edition of iMPACT! before Unbreakable 2005, the Candido Cup reaches a crescendo in the finals as Shocker & Chris Sabin try to co-exist against Sean Waltman & Alex Shelley.

videos.title: Best Of Total Nonstop Action Wrestling 2005 #1
videos.overview: A compilation of some of the best wrestling action from 2005 as Alex Shelley goes one-on-one with Samoa Joe, Jeff Jarrett battles Monty Brown, and a replay of the Ultimate X match from Final Resolution 2005 involving AJ Styles, Chris Sabin and Petey Williams.

videos.title: Best Of Total Nonstop Action Wrestling 2005 #2
videos.overview: It's a Best of 2005 episode of iMPACT! as Monty Brown takes on Abyss and Raven in a Triple Threat Match, and Christopher Daniels battles AJ Styles in a 30 minute Iron Man Match for the X-Division Title from Against All Odds.

videos.title: October 1, 2005
videos.overview: It's the first edition of iMPACT! on Spike TV with a match between X-Division Champion AJ Styles and Roderick Strong, Alex Shelley battles Petey Williams and Chris Sabin in a Triple Threat Match, and more.

videos.title: October 8, 2005
videos.overview: iMPACT! opens with a battle between 3 Live Kru and Team Canada, and continues with in a three-way dance between Matt Bentley, Christopher Daniels and Austin Aries. In the main event, America's Most Wanted battles Team 3D.

videos.title: October 15, 2005
videos.overview: Monty Brown battles Jerrelle Clark and Mikey Batts in a 2-On-1 Handicap Match, Christopher Daniels attempts to defeat three X-Division stars in under 15 minutes in an Iron Man Challenge, and Team 3D is laid to rest!

videos.title: October 22, 2005
videos.overview: Samoa Joe battles Elix Skipper, The Naturals put their tag gold on the line against America's Most Wanted, and X-Division champ AJ Styles, Jeff Hardy and Lance Hoyt team to face Jeff Jarrett, Monty Brown and Abyss.

videos.title: October 29, 2005
videos.overview: In the opening contest, Abyss takes on Lance Hoyt, then the team of Alex Shelley & Roderick Strong battle AJ Styles & Sonjay Dutt. In the main event, the NWA Tag Team Titles are on the line as America's Most Wanted defend against 3 Live Kru.

videos.title: November 3, 2005
videos.overview: On a special two-hour primetime episode, X-Division Champion AJ Styles teams with Austin Aries and Sonjay Dutt to take on Samoa Joe, Christopher Daniels & Alex Shelley. Team 3D renews their feud with Team Canada and more.

videos.title: November 10, 2005
videos.overview: With the Genesis pay-per-view less than 24 hours away, the stars of IMPACT! look to gain momentum heading into the big event. Samoa Joe battles Austin Aries with Christopher Daniels on commentary and more.

videos.title: November 17, 2005
videos.overview: Coming off an incredible Genesis event, the roster turns their attention towards Turning Point next month on pay-per-view. America's Most Wanted takes to the ring for tag team action but are paid a visit by Team 3D!

videos.title: November 24, 2005
videos.overview: After attacking Christian Cage last week, Monty Brown is in singles action against Helvis. We receive an injury update on Christopher Daniels after his brutal beatdown at the hands of Samoa Joe and more.

videos.title: December 3, 2005
videos.overview: As we continue on the road to Turning Point 2005, Christian Cage continues to be a thorn in the side of the NWA Worlds Heavyweight Champion, Jeff Jarrett.

videos.title: December 10, 2005
videos.overview: With Turning Point 2005 just three nights away, the stars of iMPACT! look to gain momentum heading into the pay-per-view event.

videos.title: December 17, 2005
videos.overview: After defeating AJ Styles for the X-Division Championship at Turning Point 2005, Samoa Joe is in singles action against Jay Lethal. X-Division action continues when Alex Shelley battles Matt Bentley and more!

videos.title: December 24, 2005
videos.overview: As the stars of iMPACT! head towards Final Resolution 2006, Christian Cage gets in the holiday spirit. Christopher Daniels takes on Team Canada's Eric Young with a special spectator watching on and more.

videos.title: December 31, 2005
videos.overview: After battle lines were drawn between Jeff Jarrett and Christian Cage last week, Jarrett teams with Monty Brown to battle Kenny King and Shark Boy. Rhino is in action against A1 of Team Canada but will the 'Monster' Abyss be lurking?

videos.title: January 1, 2006
videos.overview: Ring in the new year with the stars of iMPACT! Witness a World Tag Team Championship match as America's Most Wanted defends against AJ Styles and Christopher Daniels, plus more!

videos.title: January 7, 2006
videos.overview: iMPACT! kicks off 2006 with a bang! As the road to Final Resolution 2006 continues, Team 3D has a tune-up match before they challenge AMW for the Tag Team Championships.

videos.title: January 14, 2006
videos.overview: With one episode of iMPACT! left until Final Resolution 2006, tensions are at an all-time high! The war between Jeff Jarrett and Sting reaches its boiling point just one night before Sting steps into the ring at Final Resolution!

videos.title: January 21, 2006
videos.overview: After a historic night of action at Final Resolution 2006, Sting is slated to make his first television appearance in five years!

videos.title: January 28, 2006
videos.overview: With just two weeks until Against All Odds 2006 on pay-per-view, we find out who Jeff Jarrett will defend the NWA Worlds Heavyweight Title against at the big show.

videos.title: February 4, 2006
videos.overview: The road to Against All Odds 2006 continues as the fans vote on who Team 3D will face at the pay-per-view. X-Division Champion Samoa Joe is lurking during a singles bout between AJ Styles and Jay Lethal and more!

videos.title: February 11, 2006
videos.overview: It's the final stop on the road to Against All Odds 2006. Witness the finals of the No.1 Contenders Tag Team Tournament to see who will challenge America's Most Wanted on pay-per-view and more.

videos.title: February 18, 2006
videos.overview: After a huge Against All Odds 2006 pay-per-view event, Christian Cage is the new World Champion. Austin Aries takes on Christopher Daniels in X-Division action and more!

videos.title: February 25, 2006
videos.overview: The stars of iMPACT! look ahead to the next pay-per-view event, Destination X 2006. As the new World Champion, Christian Cage has a target on his back and a new challenger makes his intentions known.

videos.title: March 4, 2006
videos.overview: World Champion Christian Cage and Monty Brown brawl as the road to Destination X continues. Before the impending eight-man war, Jeff Jarrett, Abyss and America's Most Wanted get tuned up for battle.

videos.title: March 11, 2006
videos.overview: The Tag Team Championships are on the line as America's Most Wanted defends the titles against The Naturals. With the World X Cup right around the corner, Sonjay Dutt, Alex Shelley and Chris Sabin battle to qualify for the tournament.

videos.title: March 18, 2006
videos.overview: Sting returned at Destination X 2006 but who did Jeff Jarrett recruit to welcome him? World X Cup Qualifying Matches continue as Sonjay Dutt takes on Elix Skipper and Matt Bentley. LAX battles Shark Boy and Norman Smiley.

videos.title: March 25, 2006
videos.overview: In a preview of the all steel-cage pay-per-view Lockdown, Team 3D battles Team Canada inside Six Sides of Steel. Jeff Jarrett and his new recruit, Scott Steiner, take on The Naturals plus more!

videos.title: April 1, 2006

videos.title: April 8, 2006

videos.title: April 13, 2006

videos.title: April 20, 2006
videos.overview: The last stop on the road to Lockdown 2006. As they prepare for Lethal Lockdown, Jeff Jarrett and America's Most Wanted battle Team 3D. Plus, we get a preview of the violence that awaits Christian Cage and Abyss!

videos.title: April 27, 2006
videos.overview: After one of the most violent nights in history at Lockdown 2006, the stars of iMPACT! must begin on the road to Sacrifice 2006. Samoa Joe defends the X-Division Championship against Jay Lethal in the main event and more.

videos.title: May 4, 2006
videos.overview: The road to Sacrifice 2006 continues. America's Most Wanted defend the NWA Tag Team Championships against AJ Styles & Christopher Daniels. After having his World Title stolen by Abyss, Christian Cage battles Alex Shelley and more.

videos.title: May 11, 2006

videos.overview: Christian Cage may have escaped Sacrifice 2006 his title intact but his greatest challenge awaits when his next title defence is announced. Looking to qualify for the big match, Abyss battles Rhino in the main event and more!

videos.title: June 21, 2012
videos.overview: The monthly Open Fight Night returns, involving the competitors in the Bound For Glory Series! All 12 Wresters in the BFG Series will be in action - 6 men make challenges, 6 will be called out! Who will take the early advantage?

videos.title: June 28, 2012
videos.overview: AJ Styles and Kurt Angle defend the TNA World Tag Team Championships against Christopher Daniels and Kazarian. Plus, TNA Gut Check continues as newcomer Taeler Hendrix faces the judges.

videos.title: July 5, 2012

videos.title: July 19, 2012
videos.overview: What will the fallout be after the "The Aces & Eights" shocking and brutal attack on Hulk Hogan & Sting? Plus, IMPACT will feature the monthly "Gut Check" challenge! Which newcomer will get a chance to join the wrestling roster?

videos.title: July 26, 2012
videos.overview: Don't miss the IMPACT debut of Chavo Guerrero, as the wrestling world hears from him for the first time! Plus, 2 huge Bound For Glory Series matches will take place: AJ Styles vs. James Storm and Kurt Angle vs. Bully Ray!

videos.title: August 30, 2012
videos.overview: With only two weeks left in the annual "Bound For Glory Series" for a shot at the World Heavyweight Championship, the stakes have never been higher! Two huge BFG Series bouts as Jeff Hardy faces Olympic gold medalist Kurt Angle.

videos.title: September 6, 2012
videos.overview: Don't miss the final 2 matches in the Bound For Glory Series! Jeff Hardy battles Samoa Joe in one featured bout, while Rob Van Dam goes against Bully Ray in other! Who will be eliminated & lose their chance at the World Title?

videos.title: September 13, 2012
videos.overview: The road to Bound For Glory officially kicks off! What will happen when Austin Aries and Jeff Hardy go face-to-face? Plus, what will be the fallout between General Manager Hulk Hogan and The Aces & 8s after No Surrender?

videos.title: October 11, 2012
videos.overview: What will happen when TNA World Champion Austin Aries comes face to face with Jeff Hardy for the final time before their World Title Match? Plus, how will Aces & 8s respond to Hulk Hogan & Sting choosing Bully Ray as a partner?

videos.title: October 18, 2012
videos.overview: Did Austin Aries retain the World Heavyweight Championship, or did "The Charismatic Enigma" Jeff Hardy finally recapture the gold? Tune in to find out who was triumphant at Bound For Glory and who will be looking for revenge!

videos.title: October 25, 2012
videos.overview: "Championship Thursday" is back, and the World Heavyweight Championship will be on the line as new titleholder "The Charismatic Enigma" Jeff Hardy defends the gold against an opponent to be select by "The Immortal" Hulk Hogan!

videos.overview: What will happen between World Heavyweight Champion Jeff Hardy and his challenger Austin Aries just days before their match at Turning Point? Plus, don't miss the huge battle between "The Phenomenal" AJ Styles and Bobby Roode!

videos.overview: Who walked away from the PPV main event Ladder Match as the World Heavyweight Champion- Jeff Hardy or Austin Aries? Plus, the lethal TNA Knockouts will be in action as a new #1 Contender to the Knockouts Championship is decided!

videos.title: November 29, 2012
videos.overview: It's Championship Thursday as Rob Van Dam defends his X-Division Championship against whichever challenger Hulk Hogan selects. Plus, how will Hogan respond to the bombshell that Austin Aries dropped at the end of last week?

videos.overview: In a huge six-man tag team main event, Jeff Hardy teams with AJ Styles & James Storm to battle Bobby Roode, Christopher Daniels & Kazarian! Don't miss the chaos that is sure to ensue just days before the "Final Resolution" PPV!

videos.title: December 13, 2012
videos.overview: Don't miss the aftermath of Final Resolution! Who walked away as the World Heavyweight Champion - Jeff Hardy or Bobby Roode? Plus, is the war just beginning between Aries & Bully Ray after the controversy involving Brooke Hogan?

videos.title: December 20, 2012
videos.overview: It's a HUGE Main Event as Jeff Hardy defends the World Title against Austin Aries! Plus, it's Championship Thursday & Tara must defend her Knockouts Title against one of these 4: Velvet Sky, Miss Tessmacher, Mickie James or ODB!

videos.title: December 27, 2012
videos.overview: It's the final Impact of 2012 as Open Fight Night returns! As we look forward to 2013, several Impact superstars have grudges they want to settle before the year ends. Plus, Daniels and Kazarian promise a shocking challenge.

videos.overview: The new year kicks off with a bang as Sting makes his long awaited return to the Impact Zone to seek revenge on Aces and 8s! Plus, the 2012 Impact Wrestler of the Year will be awarded.

videos.overview: Sting is back and his war for revenge against The Aces & Eights is just starting! Plus, a huge tag team match is scheduled as World Heavyweight Champion Jeff Hardy and a partner of his choice battle Austin Aries and Bobby Roode!

videos.overview: Wedding bells will ring as Bully Ray & Brooke Hogan are married LIVE in the middle of the ring! The big question is how will Brooke's father, Hulk Hogan, react to the wedding? Plus, don't miss the aftermath of the Genesis event!

videos.title: January 3, 2019
videos.overview: With just days remaining until Homecoming live on pay-per-view, a huge main event is in store as IMPACT World Champion Johnny Impact teams up Brian Cage against The Lucha Bros — Pentagon Jr. and Fenix. The Desi Hit Squad will be in action against the duo of Fallah Bahh and KM, as both teams look to impress Scarlett Bordeaux. In Knockouts action, Allie goes one-on-one with Kiera Hogan. Eli Drake has requested time to confront Abyss in the middle of the ring ahead of their Monster’s Ball match. Plus Matt Sydal and Ethan Page will join forces with Sami Callihan and oVe against Rich Swann, Willie Mack and The Rascalz.

videos.title: January 11, 2019
videos.overview: After narrowly escaping Homecoming with his IMPACT World Championship, Johnny Impact plans to address the crowd at The Asylum in Nashville. In a Homecoming rematch, Sami Callihan goes one-on-one with Willie Mack. The Lucha Brothers take on The Rascalz in a high-octane tag team match. The new IMPACT X-Division Champion Rich Swann will be in the building. Tessa Blanchard will be in action. Plus Scarlett Bordeaux has a special surprise planned for IMPACT Wrestling’s debut on Pursuit Channel.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: This week on IMPACT!, Scarlett Bordeaux will finally pick a winner in her talent search. IMPACT Tag Team Champions LAX will take on oVe in a non-title match. “Dark” Allie will face the powerhouse Jordynne Grace. Eddie Edwards goes one-on-one with Ethan Page. We’ll hear from IMPACT Knockouts Champion Taya Valkyrie for the first time since the heinous attack by Killer Kross at Homecoming. Plus X-Division Champion Rich Swann will be in action against Trey of The Rascalz in a non-title match.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: IMPACT! emanates from Mexico City as Johnny Impact goes one-on-one with Killer Kross for the IMPACT World Championship. In a non-title match, X-Division Champion Rich Swann takes on El Hijo de Vikingo. IMPACT Knockouts Champion Taya Valkyrie meets Keyra. The Rascalz battle The Desi Hit Squad. After impressive showings in Ultimate X at Homecoming, Ethan Page and Trey of The Rascalz will face off. Plus we’ll get our first glimpse at Scarlett Bordeaux training for her in-ring debut.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: In the main event of IMPACT! from Mexico City, World Champion Johnny Impact and rival Brian Cage must join forces against Killer Kross and Moose. The Lucha Brothers team up with Taurus against the trio of LAX and Daga. Team AAA standout Psycho Clown goes one-on-one with Team IMPACT’s Fallah Bahh in a preview of the IMPACT World Cup. Plus The Rascalz take on the unlikely duo of Eddie Edwards and Eli Drake. In Knockouts tag team action, Su Yung and Dark Allie collide with Kiera Hogan and Jordynne Grace. We’ll also hear from Tessa Blanchard following her suspension by management. Scarlett Bordeaux opens the doors to her training camp. And X-Division Champion Rich Swann sits down to discuss his past with Sami Callihan.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: IMPACT! emanates from Mexico City with a blockbuster rematch set for the main event, as IMPACT Tag Team Champions LAX defend their titles against The Lucha Brothers — Pentagon Jr. & Fenix. Allie goes one-on-one with Kiera Hogan. We’ll see another preview of Team AAA vs. Team IMPACT in next week’s IMPACT World Cup when Puma King takes on Sami Callihan. Trey represents The Rascalz as he faces off with Rohit Raju of The Desi Hit Squad. Rich Swann teams up with Willie Mack against oVe. Scarlett Bordeaux checks in with another update from her training camp. Plus we’ll hear from IMPACT World Champion Johnny Impact ahead of his championship defense next week when IMPACT Wrestling presents Uncaged.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: IMPACT Wrestling presents Uncaged from Mexico City, as IMPACT World Champion Johnny Impact puts his title on the line against Brian Cage, Killer Kross and Moose in a 4 Way match. The Knockouts Championship will also be contested in a rematch when Champion Taya Valkyrie battles Tessa Blanchard in a street fight. Plus the IMPACT World Cup pits Team IMPACT against Team AAA in an elimination match. We’ll also hear from Konnan and LAX after losing the IMPACT Tag Team titles last week and Scarlett Bordeaux makes final preparations ahead of her in-ring debut next week in Las Vegas.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: IMPACT Wrestling invades Las Vegas with a hard-hitting clash for the IMPACT World Tag Team Championship, as LAX challenge The Lucha Brothers in the main event. After narrowly escaping with his IMPACT World Championship last week at Uncaged, Johnny Impact will address the crowd. The Desi Hit Squad battle Trey and Wentz of The Rascalz. Eddie Edwards seeks revenge as he goes one-on-one with Eli Drake. Alisha takes on Delilah Doom. Plus Don Callis will reveal a new hire.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: In the main event of IMPACT! from Las Vegas, World Champion Johnny Impact joins forces with Brian Cage against the team of Killer Kross and Moose. Sami Callihan is ready to tell the world more about his past with Rich Swann — will this be a bombshell Swann doesn’t want the world to know? Callihan looks to send a message through his oVe disciples, as Jake Crist battles Swann's close friend Willie Mack. Delilah Doom didn’t have the debut she dreamed about last week, but she gets her chance at revenge when she goes one-on-one with former Knockouts Champion Tessa Blanchard. Plus two of IMPACT Wrestling’s bright young stars will collide as Wentz of The Rascalz meets Ethan Page.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: IMPACT! emanates from Las Vegas and we’ll get on update on World Champion Johnny Impact and Brian Cage after both men were taken to the hospital last week. IMPACT World Tag Team Champions The Lucha Brothers, Pentagon Jr. and Fenix, will take on The Rascalz, Dez and Wentz, in a thrilling tag team encounter. The Dark War over Allie’s possession will feature Team Rosemary against Team Su, as Rosemary, Kiera Hogan and Jordynne Grace join forces against Su Yung, Allie and the Undead Maid of Honor. X-Division Champion Rich Swann will go one-on-one with “All Ego” Ethan Page. The magical man has vowed to make a splash, as Ace Austin makes his in-ring debut. Plus Alisha Edwards has an announcement about her future.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Rich Swann, Willie Mack & Tommy Dreamer go to battle against Sami Callihan & oVe (Jake & Dave Crist), and Johnny IMPACT puts the IMPACT World Championship on the line against Brian Cage in a Homecoming rematch!

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: IMPACT! emanates from Las Vegas, as World Champion Johnny Impact and Knockouts Champion Taya Valkyrie explain their heinous actions last week. Sami Callihan will finally challenge X-Division Champion Rich Swann in the main event. Moose goes one-on-one with Trey. Willie Mack takes on Ethan Page. The unlikely team of Eli Drake and Eddie Edwards look to find common ground again when they take on KM and Fallah Bahh. Plus Ace Austin looks to go 2-0 in an IMPACT Wrestling ring.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: The Undead Realm returns at Against All Odds this week on IMPACT!, as Rosemary tries to rescue Allie’s soul from the darkness when she confronts Su Yung and Father James Mitchell. In a match that screams heavyweight encounter, Brian Cage, the No. 1 contender for the IMPACT World Championship at Rebellion, goes one-on-one with the maniacal Killer Kross. IMPACT Knockouts Champion Taya Valkyrie defends her title against Jordynne Grace. Gail Kim was suspended for putting her hands on Tessa Blanchard and now Tessa is demanding an apology this week in Las Vegas. Will she get what she’s looking for? Plus the countdown to Scarlett Bordeaux’s in-ring debut is finally over, as “The Smoke Show" steps into the ring for the first time against Glenn Gilbertti.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: IMPACT! returns to Windsor, Ontario, Canada, as Eli Drake and Eddie Edwards look to keep their momentum rolling when they take on IMPACT World Tag Team Champions The Lucha Brothers, Pentagon Jr. and Fenix. IMPACT World Champion Johnny Impact and No. 1 contender Brian Cage will be in the same building ahead of their clash at Rebellion. In a 6-man X-Division showcase, it will be Petey Williams vs. Trey of The Rascalz vs. Idris Abraham vs. Jake Crist of oVe vs. Aiden Prince vs. Ace Austin. Sami Callihan and Madman Fulton will do battle with Rich Swann and Willie Mack. Fallah Bahh goes one-on-one with Rohit Raju. We’ll witness the fallout from The Undead Realm, as Rosemary speaks after witnessing Allie’s demise last week. Plus we’ll see a career retrospective of Gail Kim.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: In this week’s IMPACT! main event from Windsor, Ontario, Canada, IMPACT World Champion Johnny Impact and Knockouts Champion Taya Valkyrie join forces against No. 1 contenders Brian Cage and Jordynne Grace. Tessa Blanchard will go one-on-one with the returning Madison Rayne. The Undead Bridesmaids will lead Su Yung into battle against Rosemary. Moose takes on Wentz of The Rascalz. Josh Alexander makes his long awaited debut, as he links up with Ethan Page to form a new team known as The North. Plus we’ll hear from oVe and its newest member Madman Fulton.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: The IMPACT World Tag Team Titles are on the line in the main event of IMPACT! this week in Windsor, Ontario, as Eli Drake and Eddie Edwards look to upset the champions Pentagon Jr. and Fenix, The Lucha Brothers. We will hear from IMPACT World Champion Johnny Impact. In a non-title match, Knockouts Champion Taya Valkyrie meets Madison Rayne. Madman Fulton goes one-on-one with Tommy Dreamer. Scarlett Bordeaux teams up with Fallah Bahh against The Desi Hit Squad. Plus Moose battles Dez of The Rascalz.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: This week’s IMPACT! main event from Windsor, Canada features a preview of Rebellion, as IMPACT World Champion Johnny Impact joins forces with World Tag Team Champions the Lucha Brothers against Brian Cage and LAX. X-Division Champion Rich Swann pays Sami Callihan a visit at the oVe compound. Killer Kross goes one-on-one with Willie Mack. Rosemary will take on the Undead Maid of Honor.
